summary: This 8-K reports entry into a $20M term loan agreement (expandable to $30M) by a wholly-owned subsidiary of NewtekOne, Inc. with D2 Asset Based Credit Partners, LP, maturing April 2029. Proceeds may be dividend to parent for general corporate purposes. The loan is secured by pledged loans and equity interests, with parent guarantee. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No special-situation category applies.
